notes.title: Steamdeck Test Patch
notes.content: I found the game crashed with an obscure video error; I've now caught this issue and dropped the video playback, so it should run nicely on the SteamDeck now!

notes.title: Patch 11b!
notes.content:
[list]
[*]-Fixed not being able to ride Doodads and opening/closing doors on Keyboard.
[*]-Health bar now correctly scales with screen resolution.
[*]-New Ban Hammer UI.
[*]-No longer able to select the "Port Forward!" text on the world enter menu.
[*]-Added "noclip" command. You must have all 15 artifacts and must be the host to use it.
[*]-Changed "Close" to "Skip" in tutorial message.
[*]-Fixed softlock when backing out of "Are you sure you want to start a new world?".
[*]-SpiderBot no longer walks off the world.
[*]-The game can now pick every resolution your monitor supports at or above 720p.
[*]-You can now use a view distance of 10 with the highest detail settings again.
[*]-Fixed banhammer "kicking" the host when trying to kick someone in your session.
[*]-Fixed menu crashes.
[*]-Fixed particles breaking when the resolution changes.
[*]-Fixed certain special effects becoming broken when the resolution changes.
[*]-(Technical) Modified world node removal. There should be no more random strips of terrain in the server map, and it will scale with your view distance.
[*]-Fixed friend requests counting as friends.
[*]-Added music volume option.
[*]-Fixed drifting options in in-game options menus.
[/list]

notes.title: Bleeding Edge raw build.
notes.content:
A couple of minor fixes here

[list]
[*]Removed 'trial mode' message - it was to do with Xbox Indie Game Trial Mode and nothing else!
[*]Players in your world carrying a banhammer will be kicked.
[/list]

Please note that this is an UNTESTED build so ensure you backup your worlds first! They are stored in the My Games folder under My Documents.
